question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints (huggingface.co resolve-redirect GGUF; llama.cpp constrained decoding; CPU-only nproc=4; no credential; no paid endpoint), does supplying the task goal and action schema in the system prompt convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion (click #reveal-btn, then answer TARGET-42) for the largest obtainable credential-free models (M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN escalation, M-0.5B-QWEN census-completion) -- and if not, what is the demonstrable capability ceiling for the minimal Web-agent task across ALL credential-free endpoints and local models actually available to the factory {E-LOCAL-LLAMA Qwen2.5 0.5B/3B/7B/14B Q4_K_M; E-POLLINATIONS-OPENAI gpt-oss-20b proxy carried endpoint-layer negative}? Return an explicit close/re-scope recommendation for readiness condition (3).
hypothesis: The parent's 0/5 negatives for M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN are caused at least partly by system-prompt underspecification (audit VF-01), not by an immutable capability ceiling. Under PR-SPECIFIED (goal + frozen selector-based schema), the models' step-0 reveal-click (observed 5/5 in the parent) converts into a full click-then-answer completion: at least one candidate in {M-7B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN} clears the bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5-episode arm), all other constraints byte-identical to the parent (same GBNF, user template, task HTML, seeds 42-46, temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, same shards, CPU-only). M-0.5B-QWEN is additionally measured as a census-completeness candidate; if it alone clears, the outcome is still SUPPORTS with that candidate recorded as the driver (no size floor in the mandate).
falsifier: Under the same constraints with PR-SPECIFIED, no model in the obtainable set {M-0.5B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN, M-14B-QWEN} measured under the frozen protocol clears the bar, while CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION confirms behavioral continuity with the parent (0/5 + reveal-click loop on M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN under PR-UNDERSPEC) and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE confirms the task/verifier can reward a correct click-then-answer (5/5). Exhaustion of the obtainable credential-free model range under identical frozen constraints, together with the carried endpoint-layer negative B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY, closes the credential-free external-agent path and licenses the explicit close/re-scope decision that readiness condition (3) is NOT satisfied; the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark must be re-scoped off the credential-free path (drop Gate 3's same-model external anchor; re-anchor on internally re-run comparators on a dynamic-range task bank per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128).

PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.description: A deterministic NON-MODEL scripted policy emits at step 1 {"action":"click","selector":"#reveal-btn"} and at step 2 {"action":"answer","text":"TARGET-42"}, through the identical episode pipeline (same page server, Playwright/chrome, parser, verifier). 5 episodes. Certifies the ceiling (a correct multi-step sequence is rewarded at 1.0), which no grammar-only control can do.
PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.success_criterion: scripted_oracle_task_success_rate == 5/5. Any value < 5/5 => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID (the task/verifier cannot reward a correct click-then-answer; no candidate negative would be interpretable).
PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE.why_it_is_a_real_control: It can fail (broken page server, Playwright binding, click mechanics or verifier all yield < 5/5), separating task/verifier integrity from model capability.

PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.description: 10/10 probes 'Emit exactly: {"action":"click","selector":"#test"}' per candidate through the identical LlamaGrammar path used for episodes. Isolates model reasoning from decoding infrastructure.
PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.success_criterion: 10/10 syntactically valid schema JSON per candidate, before any task episode of that candidate.
PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING.why_it_is_a_real_control: It can fail (broken grammar/build does), separating decoding infrastructure from model capability; identical to the parent's passing control.

NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.description: Run the minimal task with a fixed invalid content producer ('I will click the button'), 5 episodes.
NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.success_criterion: 0% parseable JSON actions and 0% task completion (reproduction of parent behavior expected).
NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION.why: Confirms the verifier rejects non-parseable actions and that completion requires model-driven actions.

parseable_action_rate_step1.definition: fraction of episodes whose step-1 action parsed to valid schema JSON

answer_action_emission_rate.definition: fraction of episodes emitting >= 1 parseable 'answer' action (click-then-answer conversion metric)

step0_reveal_click_rate.definition: fraction of episodes with a click on '#reveal-btn' at step 1 (parent observed 5/5)

loop_signature_rate.definition: fraction of episodes with >= 1 post-reveal click on the now-hidden '#reveal-btn'

mean_inference_latency_s.definition: mean per-step inference latency per candidate

mean_completion_tokens.definition: mean per-step completion tokens per candidate

candidate_cleared_bar.definition: derived bool: parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6 over the 5-episode PR-SPECIFIED arm

obtainable_set_complete.definition: derived bool: every candidate in the pre-declared obtainable set was measured under PR-SPECIFIED (no NOT_MEASURED record)

decision_rule:
Arms (frozen). Candidate order: M-7B-QWEN -> M-3B-QWEN -> (conditional) M-14B-QWEN -> (census-completeness) M-0.5B-QWEN. Obtainable set (pre-declared, non-outcome-bearing): M-0.5B-QWEN, M-3B-QWEN, M-7B-QWEN are always in the obtainable set; M-14B-QWEN joins iff all 3 shards download with pinned content-lengths AND available memory >= 11 GiB at load time. Otherwise M-14B-QWEN is recorded NOT_IN_OBTAINABLE_SET (reason RAM or PROVISIONING) and excluded by this pre-declared definition (bounded ceiling, not a scientific negative). 'Largest obtainable' is defined by the runner's ~16 GiB RAM under CPU-only llama.cpp: Qwen2.5-14B Q4_K_M (~8.37 GiB weights) fits; Qwen2.5-32B Q4_K_M is 19,851,336,384 B (~18.49 GiB) across 5 shards (first shard alone 3,961,498,272 B; HTTP-verified at DESIGN) and Qwen2.5-72B is larger still, so 32B/72B are NOT_IN_OBTAINABLE_SET by the same memory definition and the E-LOCAL-LLAMA Q4_K_M range ends at 14B. Per candidate: PC-JSON (10/10) -> PR-UNDERSPEC (5 episodes; M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN only = CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION) -> PR-SPECIFIED (5 episodes). M-14B-QWEN and M-0.5B-QWEN run PR-SPECIFIED only, after PC. PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE runs once, before any model episode.

Bar cleared iff parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 AND task_success_rate >= 0.6 over the 5-episode PR-SPECIFIED arm (>= 3/5 both; success mechanically requires clicked_reveal==True and exact answer TARGET-42).

Ordered evaluation (outcome in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MIXED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}; status in {COMPLETE, BLOCKED, MEASUREMENT_INVALID}):
1. PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE != 5/5 => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. PC-JSON fails on BOTH M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN => MEASUREMENT_INVALID. A candidate whose PC-JSON fails is NOT_MEASURED-PC-FAIL (not a capability negative).
2. CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION PASS iff for EACH of M-7B-QWEN and M-3B-QWEN: task_success_rate == 0/5 AND step0_reveal_click_rate >= 0.8 AND loop_signature_rate >= 0.2 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.8. ANY unmet condition on either model (incl. a clear under PR-UNDERSPEC or any task success > 0/5) => OUTCOME=MEASUREMENT_INVALID reason REPLICATION-DEVIATION (ablation unidentifiable). Raw observations still reported.
3. Run PR-SPECIFIED for the next candidate. If any measured candidate clears => SUPPORTS (early stop; remaining candidates NOT_ATTEMPTED-EARLY-STOP, never negatives); the first candidate in frozen order that clears is recorded as the proven same-model driver (all clearing candidates also recorded).
4. If replication PASS and no candidate clears (all measured candidates fail the bar):
   a. Every candidate in the obtainable set measured under PR-SPECIFIED and failed => FALSIFIES. Ceiling = measured E-LOCAL-LLAMA range + carried proxy negative; issue the close/re-scope recommendation.
   b. Any candidate in the obtainable set unresolved for a non-capability reason (NOT_MEASURED: download/shard/load/build/PC-fail) => MIXED; the negative is bounded to the measured subset and the unresolved arm is recorded UNRESOLVED.
5. Infrastructure failure preventing measurement => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (never a scientific negative); status=BLOCKED only if no measurement result exists at all. A valid scientific negative is status=COMPLETE with outcome FALSIFIES.
claim_ceiling_rules: The result bounds capability ONLY for the frozen minimal two-step synthetic task, the frozen prompts, the frozen sampling and the measured credential-free candidates. SUPPORTS licenses readiness condition (3) for this task class with the recorded driver; FALSIFIES/MIXED bounds the credential-free driver set for this task class. No generalization to arbitrary multi-step web tasks; no Product-Core promotion; no claim-status change by this packet.

self_attack_resolutions: CEILING: PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE 5/5 so a universal negative cannot be an unpassable-task artifact.
AVAILABILITY: 14B is gated by a pre-declared definition (RAM>=11 GiB and shard download), recorded NOT_IN_OBTAINABLE_SET rather than silently forced into FALSIFIES.

LARGEST-OBTAINABLE DEFINITION: the E-LOCAL-LLAMA Q4_K_M range ends at 14B because 32B (~18.49 GiB) and 72B exceed the runner's ~16 GiB RAM; the 'largest obtainable' clause of the mandate is therefore satisfied by a pre-declared memory definition, not an arbitrary size cut.
REPLICATION MIDDLE: CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION is all-or-nothing; any partial deviation => REPLICATION-DEVIATION => MEASUREMENT_INVALID (no undefined middle).
PROTOCOL-MISMATCHED NEGATIVE: M-0.5B-QWEN is measured under the frozen GBNF protocol (the census unconstrained result is a different protocol and does not transfer).

PROMPT FIDELITY: PR-SPECIFIED is byte-frozen to the grand-parent census SYS literal (min_webagent.py SYS) with exactly two token-level adaptations inside the click example: the schema key ref->selector (the frozen grammar accepts only keys selector/text) and its placeholder <id>-><css selector> (the harness normalizes a selector with a leading '#'). Every other word, including the opening constraint sentence and the goal sentence 'Click the button to reveal the code, then answer it.', is verbatim; the leak guard holds.

PREREQUISITE HONESTY: the runner image ships chrome but not llama-cpp-python/playwright; both are pinned, PyPI-verified at DESIGN and were already built/run in the parent EXECUTE - a reproduced provisioning path, not an unproven assumption.
ARTIFACTS: freeze_artifacts lists the pre-existing mutable local inputs (incl. the treatment-provenance source min_webagent.py); the EXECUTE harness does not exist at freeze and is bound at EXECUTE.

CONTROL SENSITIVITY: NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION (verifier rejects) and B-RANDOM-ACTION (verifier does not accept chance) both exercise the same scoring path; PC-JSON and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE certify decoding and ceiling on that same path.

product_consequence_positive: Readiness condition (3) is satisfied by a proven credential-free same-model driver (model id + shard hashes). The four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT benchmark becomes executable as frozen: same model/tools/budget across COLD, INSTRUCTIONS, RETRIEVAL, SPIDER arms on a dynamic-range task bank. Intel hands Product/Graph a verified credential-free endpoint certificate (E-LOCAL-LLAMA + model receipt). C-LLM-INHERIT advances from HYPOTHESIS toward EXPERIMENTAL (DIRECTOR decision).
product_consequence_negative: Readiness condition (3) is demonstrated NOT satisfiable on the credential-free path up to the measured ceiling. C-LLM-INHERIT must be re-scoped: drop Gate 3's same-model external published-baseline anchor; require internally re-run comparators (same harness, frozen seeds) on a task bank with demonstrable dynamic range (cold and retrieval must NOT saturate at 1.0 at high novelty, per EXP-PRODUCT-37973256064/EXP-PRODUCT-37950607128). The close/re-scope recommendation is the deliverable for the Global Research Director; no promotion of any credential-free endpoint into Product Core is authorized by this experiment.

expected_information_gain: Decisive for readiness condition (3). It resolves the single open ambiguity named by the audit (VF-01): whether the parent's 0/5 is a prompt-underspecification artifact or an immutable capability ceiling for a minimal multi-step Web-agent task, and grounds the ceiling claim across ALL obtainable local models under the identical frozen protocol (fixing the census's unconstrained-0.5B protocol gap). Both directions change a program decision: SUPPORTS unblocks the flagship four-arm benchmark as frozen; FALSIFIES/MIXED closes the credential-free path with an explicit accountable re-scope and removes a three-claim bottleneck (C-LLM-INHERIT, C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY, C-PRODUCT-ECON). The within-experiment replication arm makes this an identifiability-safe ablation rather than a version-fragile re-run.

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome branch is reachable from frozen, mechanically verifiable states (see pre_freeze_satisfiability_dry_run.branch_reachability_matrix). SUPPORTS: any measured candidate clears under PR-SPECIFIED (completion verified mechanically). FALSIFIES: PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE 5/5, replication PASS, and every candidate in the obtainable set measured and failing; because M-14B is either in the obtainable set (and measured) or excluded by the pre-declared availability definition, the obtainable set is always fully measureable when downloads succeed, so FALSIFIES is reachable independently of the RAM gate. MIXED: a candidate in the obtainable set is unresolved for a non-capability reason. MEASUREMENT_INVALID: scripted-oracle failure, both-PC failure, replication deviation, or infra failure - all defined. Thresholds (>=3/5) are arithmetically attainable (0..5 range). Precedence is acyclic: the oracle/PC/replication gates precede the capability verdict and never make a later branch unreachable for a valid run.

baseline_identifiability.reason: PR-SPECIFIED vs PR-UNDERSPEC differ ONLY in the system-prompt string; GBNF grammar, task HTML, user template, seeds (42-46), temperature 0.0, max_tokens 512, n_ctx 2048, chat_format qwen, model shards (byte-pinned), verifier and episode count are identical to the parent fixture (path+sha256). PR-SPECIFIED is the grand-parent census SYS literal with exactly two token-level adaptations in the click example: key ref->selector (the frozen grammar accepts only keys selector/text) and placeholder <id>-><css selector>; the goal sentence is verbatim; the leak guard holds (neither prompt contains '#reveal-btn' nor 'TARGET-42'). The comparator is re-anchored in-experiment by CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION (expected 0/5 + loop on both models), so drift fires an identifiable discontinuity. This is NOT a ceiling/floor situation: the parent already shows partial capability (step-1 reveal-click 5/5, parseable 1.0) so the arms are not guaranteed identical, B-RANDOM bounds the chance floor and PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE bounds the ceiling at 1.0. Cost metrics (mean_inference_latency_s, mean_completion_tokens) are recorded identically for both arms, so no comparator omits a cost dimension used by the other.

control_sensitivity.reason: Every control has a pre-declared expected value and failure meaning (control_registry) and runs through the same episode/scoring implementation. PC-SCRIPTED-ORACLE must return 5/5 and can fail if the page/verifier is broken (certifies the ceiling at 1.0). PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING must return 10/10 and can fail on a broken grammar/build. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION must return 0 parseable/0 success (verifier rejects non-actions). B-RANDOM-ACTION must return chance-level success (verifier does not accept chance). CV-UNDERSPEC-REPLICATION must reproduce 0/5+loop and fires if the harness/environment drifts. The parent already observed discriminating values for PC-JSON (10/10), NC (0/0) and B-RANDOM (5/5 valid JSON, 0/5 success); no control is tautological or impossible.
